export_geo_for_wrap.tip: Export the selected body to wrap.
export_geo_for_wrap.what: Exports the selected geo as an obj so the base mesh can be wrapped onto it in Wrap 3D.
steps: Wrap the base mesh onto it in Wrap 3D.
Save the alembic in the data folder.
examples: Select the character body and click it.
Export a new outfit body to wrap.
export_geo_for_wrap.details: Writes <SID>_ForWrapGeo (or Model_ForWrapGeo) .obj, versioned, into <workspace>/data (modeling path swapped for rigging).

export_geo_for_wrap_face.tip: Export the selected head to wrap.
export_geo_for_wrap_face.what: Exports the selected head geo as an obj for wrapping the face.
examples: Select the head and click it.
Export a creature head.

open_wrap_3d.what: Starts Wrap 3D to fit the base mesh to your character.
examples: Click it after exporting.
Open Wrap to fit the base mesh to a sculpt.
open_wrap_3d.details: Runs r3ds_wrap (or "sclenv r3ds_wrap" on studio Linux).

open_folder_with_wrapped_geos.what: Opens the folder where the exported and wrapped geos are saved.
examples: Check Wrap saved the alembic there.
Check the abc from Wrap was saved.

import_wrapped_geo.what: Imports the newest wrapped alembic from the project data folder.
examples: Click it after Wrap finished.
Import the newest wrap after fixing it in Wrap.
import_wrapped_geo.details: Imports the newest .abc (by date) in <workspace>/data. transf0 is the base mesh wrapped onto your character (what Wrap exports); the tools use it when it exists, else the base mesh.

auto_zombify.tip: Run every body step at once.
auto_zombify.what: Imports the biped guide, places it on the wrapped geo, builds the rig, loads the skin and the ROM.
steps: Pick T or A pose and the skin version.
examples: Import the wrapped geo, click it and wait: you get a rigged, skinned body.
Rig a scanned or sculpted character in minutes.
Run it on every new zombie variant.
auto_zombify.details: run_zombify(): import_biped_guide, auto_place_guides, build_rig, load_skinning, load_rom in a row. If one step fails, run the next ones with their own buttons.

import_biped_guide.what: Creates the human body template blocks.
examples: Step 1 when running the body steps by hand.
Import the guide to place it by hand instead.
import_biped_guide.details: exec_humanBodyTemplate.create_humanBodyTemplate_block(); opens the AutoRigger to import it if the block module is not found.

auto_place_guides.tip: Place the guides on the wrapped geo.
auto_place_guides.what: Moves the guides to the wrapped base mesh, in T or A pose (pick it above).
examples: Step 2: click it and check the knees and elbows.
Use A pose for characters modeled with arms down.
auto_place_guides.details: wrap_utils.place_mutant_on_wrap_geo(): the guides follow stored vertices of the base mesh topology, then the T / A pose fixes run. transf0 is the base mesh wrapped onto your character (what Wrap exports); the tools use it when it exists, else the base mesh.

build_rig.what: Builds the AutoRigger blocks with only the progress bar showing.
examples: Step 3: click it once the guides look right.
Rebuild after fixing guides.

load_skinning.what: Loads the base mesh skin version picked in the list on the wrapped geo.
examples: Step 4: click it after building.
Load another skin version and compare.
load_skinning.details: Loads Utils/Wrap/BaseMesh/<basemesh>/Skins/<version>/<basemesh>.json on transf0 (or the base mesh).

copy_skinning_to_sel.tip: Copy the skin to the selected geos.
copy_skinning_to_sel.what: Copies the skin weights from the wrapped base mesh to each selected geo.
examples: Select clothes and props and click it so they deform with the body.
Copy skin to torn clothes.
copy_skinning_to_sel.details: copySkinWeights from transf0 to each selected geo; geos without skin get bound to *_Bnd first.

examples: Open it to fix a few weights after copying skins.
Fix guide orients in Helpers.

load_roms.what: Opens the AnimLoader to put a range of motion on the rig.
examples: Load a ROM and check the deformation.
Load a ROM to check deformation.

reset_arms.what: Puts the arm guides back in a straight line with the right lengths.
examples: Click it when the arm guides came out bent.
Reset when the elbow guide bent backwards.
reset_arms.details: Re-places the arm guides in a straight line keeping the measured bone lengths.

reset_legs.what: Puts the leg guides back in a straight line with the right lengths.
examples: Click it when the leg guides came out bent.
Reset when the knee guide went behind the leg.
reset_legs.details: Re-places the leg guides in a straight line keeping the measured bone lengths.

unparent_guides.what: Takes the guides out of their hierarchy so you can move each one alone.
examples: Unparent, move a single guide, then Parent Guides.
Unparent to move only the elbow guide.
unparent_guides.details: Stores the block order and hierarchy, then unparents every guide under the *_Block nodes (PhonemesUI_Block is skipped).

parent_guides.what: Puts the guides back in their hierarchy and block order.
examples: Click it after Unparent Guides and your fixes.
Parent back before building.
parent_guides.details: Skeletor.parent_hierarchy(stored hierarchy) + wrap_utils.reorder_block_guides(stored order). Use it after Unparent in the same session.

import_face_guide.what: Creates the human face template blocks.
examples: Step 1 for the face.
Import the face guide for a zombie face.

load_eyeball_geo.tip: Use the selected object as the eyeball geo.
load_eyeball_geo.what: Select the eyeball geo in the scene and click <<: its name goes in the field next to the button.
examples: Select the left eyeball and click <<.
Select several objects to fill the load eyeball geo field with all of them.
load_eyeball_geo.details: put_selection_on_field(): the selection names, comma separated.

load_face_geo.tip: Use the selected object as the face geo.
load_face_geo.what: Select the face geo in the scene and click <<: its name goes in the field next to the button.
examples: Select the head mesh and click <<.
Select several objects to fill the load face geo field with all of them.
load_face_geo.details: put_selection_on_field(): the selection names, comma separated.

auto_place_guides_face.what: Moves the face guides to the wrapped geo and fixes the eye and face orientations.
examples: Fill the eyeball and face fields, click it.
Place face guides on a wrapped head.
auto_place_guides_face.details: place_mutant_on_wrap_geo() then fix_all_face_orientations(eyeball, face_geo). transf0 is the base mesh wrapped onto your character (what Wrap exports); the tools use it when it exists, else the base mesh.

build_rig_face.what: Builds the face blocks with only the progress bar showing.
examples: Click it after placing the face guides.
Build the face after the body.

load_skinning_face.what: Loads the face skin version picked in the list.
examples: Click it after building the face.
Load the face skin version that matches the body.
load_skinning_face.details: Loads Utils/Wrap/BaseMesh/<basemesh>/Skins/<version>/BodyEyes.json and the other face head skins.

create_real_head_based_on_sel.tip: Use the selected object as the real head.
create_real_head_based_on_sel.what: Select the real head in the scene and click <<: its name goes in the field next to the button.
examples: Select your character head and click <<.
Select several objects to fill the create real head based on sel field with all of them.
create_real_head_based_on_sel.details: put_selection_on_field(): the selection names, comma separated.

create_face_geos.what: Makes the face rig heads (skull, eyes, lips, brows...) from the real head in the field.
examples: Fill the real head field and click it.
Make the face heads for a new character.
create_face_geos.details: Makes the face rig heads (BodySkull, BodyEyes, BodyLips, BodyBrows, BodyCheeks, BodyJaw, BodyNose, BodyMouthUp / Down / Wide / Narrow, BodySquash) from the real head.

copy_skinning_to_sel_face.tip: Copy the skin to the face geos.
copy_skinning_to_sel_face.what: Copies the face skinning to every face rig geo.
examples: Click it after Create Face Geos.
Copy face skin after Create Face Geos.
copy_skinning_to_sel_face.details: For each face head: binds it to its joint set, then copies weights from Wrap_<geo>.

add_to_extra_geos_line.tip: Use the selected object as the extra geos.
add_to_extra_geos_line.what: Select the extra geos in the scene and click <<: its name goes in the field next to the button.
examples: Select the eyebrows and eyelashes and click <<.
Select several objects to fill the add to extra geos line field with all of them.
add_to_extra_geos_line.details: put_selection_on_field(): the selection names, comma separated.

add_extra_geos.tip: Add the extra geos to the face.
add_extra_geos.what: Makes the local system for the selected extra geos so they follow the face.
examples: Select eyelashes and eyebrows and click it.
Add teeth and tongue geos.
add_extra_geos.details: Rebuilds Local_Extra / Skull_Local_Extra groups: extra geos get local copies that follow the face rig.

examples: Open it to fix the face weights.
Fix face weights in Helpers.

load_guides.what: Puts the selected joints in the field, comma separated.
examples: Select the joints to keep when updating the geo and click it.
Keep only the spine joints while updating the geo.

update_geo.tip: Swap the old geo for the new one.
update_geo.what: Select the old geo, then the new geo. Moves the rig and skin from the old geo to the new one.
steps: Select the joints to keep with << Joints (or leave it empty for the guides).
Select the old geo, then the new geo.
examples: The model changed: select old, then new, and click it.
Swap a WIP model for the final one keeping the rig.
update_geo.details: Saves the skeleton / skin to %TEMP%/ZombinatorTemp, then moves them from the old geo to the new one (Skeletor).

f_help.what: Points you to www.mutanttools.com for the Zombinator guide.
examples: Click it when you are stuck.
Read the online guide for Wrap tips.
f_help.details: Only prints www.mutanttools.com in the script editor.
